about: The reader's words, held by app/test_teaching_text.mjs (F8(a), admitted 27 Sep 2026). `retired` lists names the reader no longer meets and what replaced each; `pattern` is a regular expression matched against teaching text with code comments removed. `in`, where given, limits a rule to those sources. Add a word here when you retire it, in the same commit, so it cannot creep back.
